dimbotanypots.tooltip.dimpot: A small pot for growing many kinds of plants. Automatically places output in the Dimensional Chest
dimbotanypots.jei.description: Change the frequency of the Pot, by right-click it with an Dimensional Chest, Dimensional Tank, Dimensional Tablet, or another Dimensional Botany Pot.\n\nAlternatively, hold one of these in your off-hand while placing the Pot to apply its frequency to the placed Pot.
dimbotanypots.chat.not_owner: Cannot change frequency. You are not the owner of this Pot
